GenAiFunction.description: Answers a question about Kotak Personal Loan Top-Up (uses, interest rate, how it differs from a new loan, disbursal speed, fees, documents, tenure, eligibility) from approved content, then re-asks whatever the journey is waiting for. Not for a request to apply for a new loan: that goes to Reply to Journey. Always pass journeyId = the journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action in this conversation (empty on the first call) and sessionId = the Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation; leave sessionId empty if no Routable Id is available.
